message.content:
This appears to come from a CBP ruling on Hairmetto hair products, which are scalp oils and serums treated as hair preparations. The heading is 3305 (preparations for use on the hair). Within it, 3305.90 covers "Other," and 3305.90.10 is the subheading for "Hair grooming preparations" (the full 10-digit line is 3305.90.1000 for "Other"). The first two products are scalp treatments and the third is a styling serum, so all three fall under "other preparations for use on the hair."

The 3305 subheadings are:
- 3305.10: shampoos
- 3305.20: preparations for permanent waving or straightening
- 3305.30: hair lacquers
- 3305.90: other, with 3305.90.10 "Hair oils/Other" (or "Hair grooming preparations")
- 3305.90.1000 does not appear as such; the 10-digit codes are 3305.90.1000, "Other"

I'll go with 3305.90.1000, though I am not fully certain of the statistical suffix.

{"hts_code": "3305.90.1000", "reason": "Scalp oil, scalp serum and styling serum are preparations for use on the hair, classified in heading 3305 under the residual subheading 3305.90 for other hair preparations."}
